basic_details.job_title: ECHS Kasauli Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 7 Driver, OIC ECHS Polyclinic and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: OIC ECHS Polyclinic, Medical Officer, Dental Hygienist, Driver
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

qualification.details: Medical and Para Medical staff must hold valid registration from the Himachal Pradesh State Medical/Para Medical Council. Only candidates meeting the qualitative requirements may apply. | See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

selection_process: Selection is through an interview at Stn HQ Kasauli
tentatively on 20 November 2026. Accepted candidates will receive final confirmation by email and/or telephone
and they must reach the venue at 9.00 am. No TA/DA is admissible.

Selected individuals must then complete 10 days of On Job Training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from the OIC Polyclinic before signing the contract (Memorandum of Agreement). This training is unpaid and is mandatory before assuming charge.
how_to_apply: Get the application format, terms and conditions from the ECHS website.
Fill in the application in the requisite format, as a hard copy.
Attach self attested photocopies of testimonials supporting your educational qualifications and work experience.
Submit the application in triplicate to OIC Stn HQ's (ECHS Cell) Kasauli so that it is received before the 4 PM cut-off.
Original certificates, mark sheets and degree of 10th/metric, 10+2 and graduation/post graduation/diploma/course

content_sections.heading: About ECHS
content_sections.text: The Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme appears on this notice's letterhead under the Government of India, Ministry of Defence. Its Station HQ (ECHS Cell) at Kasauli issued this notice to engage medical, para medical and non medical staff for three ECHS Polyclinics.

rows.event: Last date of receipt of application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview at Stn HQ Kasauli, tentatively on 20 November 2026. Accepted candidates will receive final confirmation by email and/or telephone, and they must reach the venue at 9.00 am. No TA/DA is admissible. Selected individuals must then complete 10 days of On Job Training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from the OIC Polyclinic before signing the contract (Memorandum of Agreement). This training is unpaid and is mandatory before assuming charge.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for one year for ESM and 11 months for civilian candidates, till attaining the maximum age, subject to performance and other conditions. A minimum of 10 days of handing and taking over will be carried out between the mentioned appointments at the Polyclinics.

faq.question: Q1. Which ECHS Polyclinics have vacancies?
faq.answer: Solan has 2 vacancies, Bilaspur has 2 and Ghumarwin has 3.

faq.question: Q2. Can civilians apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Civilians can apply for Medical Officer (40%), Dental Hygienist (30%) and Driver (30%). The OIC ECHS Polyclinic post is 100% reserved for ESM.

faq.question: Q3. Who gets preference in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen, Veer Naris and Widows of Service Personnel.

faq.question: Q4. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The period is one year for ESM and 11 months for civilian candidates.

faq.question: Q5. How many copies of the application are required?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted in triplicate, with self attested photocopies of testimonials.

faq.question: Q6. What time must candidates reach the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must reach Stn HQ Kasauli at 9.00 am.

faq.question: Q7. Is the On Job Training paid?
faq.answer: No. The 10 days of OJT remain unpaid and must be completed before assuming charge.

faq.question: Q8. Is state council registration required?
faq.answer: Yes. Medical and Para Medical staff need valid registration from the Himachal Pradesh State Medical/Para Medical Council.

faq.question: Q9. Who can I contact for more details?
faq.answer: Call Stn HQ ECHS Cell on 01792-273215, write to [email protected], or approach the respective ECHS Polyclinic.
